Conheça a Blanver:
A Blanver é uma empresa brasileira com mais de 41 anos de história marcada pela inovação e empreendedorismo. A experiência e atuação no desenvolvimento, fabricação e comercialização de medicamentos e insumos farmacêuticos ativos (IFAs) tornou a Blanver especialista nos segmentos de HIV, Hepatite e Osteoporose, oferecendo produtos de alta qualidade, atendendo pacientes no Brasil por meio de parcerias com o Ministério da Saúde e laboratórios oficiais. Além disso, também estamos presentes nos segmentos de Oncologia, Doenças Raras e Hematologia, por meio de parcerias estratégias com grandes parceiros internacionais.
As operações do Grupo Blanver contam com duas plantas de produção no Brasil – uma na cidade de Taboão da Serra, onde são fabricados os medicamentos, e a outra em Indaiatuba, para a produção de IFAs. Além destas, temos um escritório central no bairro Morumbi em São Paulo e uma filial de expedição na cidade de Itajaí, SC. Acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a grande diferença na consolidação dos nossos negócios e estamos dedicados a desenvolver equipes em que cada pessoa é reconhecida por sua experiência e suas contribuições exclusivas.
Essas serão algumas atividades do seu dia a dia como Analista de GQ Sênior (Qualificação de Fornecedores):
Realizar visitas e auditorias a fornecedores, fabricantes e prestadores de serviços nacionais e internacionais, para verificação do cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Fabricação, e elaborar relatórios específicos, garantindo a qualidade do produto.
Orientar e executar as a atividades do sistema de gestão da qualidade e validação, seguindo norma da Anvisa e outras agências reguladores entre outras normas aplicáveis, para garantir a aderência aos parâmetros das normas nacionais e internacionais, conforme exigências do mercado, o aprimoramento dos processos e colaboradores, qualidade dos produtos e a satisfação dos clientes.
Realizar o controle de fabricantes, fornecedores, prestadores de serviços, transportadoras, operadores logísticos, entre outros, da empresa.
Executar o programa de Autoinspeções, apresentando as documentações solicitadas, bem como auditar os setores necessários, solicitando evidências a fim de comprovar os itens de boas práticas de fabricação.
Realizar a reconciliação (fazer conferências das instruções de fabricação e de embalagens dos produtos) de ordem de produtiva, a fim de detectar possíveis de desvios de qualidade e tomar as providências cabíveis.
Elaborar indicadores de qualidade de qualificação de fornecedores e apresentar comitê de qualificação de fornecedores.
Requisitos:
Superior completo em Farmácia;
Disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais;
Inglês avançado (testado em entrevista);
Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência na área;
Conhecimento na legislação RDC 658/2022 e demais guias da qualidade emitidos pela ANVISA e guias internacionais, como WHO, PICs, guidelines FDA;
Habilidade de relacionamento interpessoal;
Possuir CNH B.

title: Senior Software Engineer - LLM / AI-Enabled Systems
description:
About Health Note
Health Note is building AI-powered digital assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. Instead of rigid,disconnected software modules, ourassistants gain skills over time — from handling simple reschedules to managing complex intake, referrals, and medication refills. Patients experience a natural,empathetic interaction, while providers gain a system that is reliable, transparent, and continually improving. Our goal is to deliver a concierge experience forevery patient, and a scalable path to automation for every clinic.
About the Role
This role is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with tremendous growth opportunities. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be responsible fordeveloping and maintaining mission-critical systems that power healthcare operations and interoperability for over 60 clinics and health systems.
At Health Note, we’re not building new AI models — we’re using services to deliver digital
assistants that act like trusted members of the care team. These assistants grow new skills over time, handle complex patient-facing workflows safely andreliably, and transform healthcare operations into a continuous improvement process. The result is not just reliable automation, but a human and empatheticexperience that patients and providers trust.
As part of a cross-functional team, you’ll collaborate with product managers, solution engineers, and client experience managers to create world-class, AI-enabled solutions. You’ll shape architectural decisions, integration patterns, and developer workflows so that AI isn’t just “bolted on,” but thoughtfullyincorporated into our platform.
This opportunity is ideal if you want to take the next step in your career and join a growth-stage organization focused on healthcare — while working at thefrontier of AI-enabled software development.
We’re a fully distributed, remote-first, fast-growing startup. Our engineering team is spread from UTC-3 to UTC-7 and we rely heavily on strong asynchronouscommunication. Occasionally, you’ll need to flex to sync up with teammates across time zones.
Our cutting-edge stack is full-stack Typescript leveraging NestJS, React, Remix, Tailwinds,GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pulumi, all on AWS. Our architecture isservice oriented and managed in a Monorepo.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable and performant servicesand applications.
Integrate LLMs and AI services into production systems, with attention tosafety, observability, performance, and cost effectiveness.
Build abstractions, APIs, and internal tooling that make it easier for otherengineers and product teams to leverage AI responsibly.
Continually improve the codebase and test coverage through refactoring,automated testing, CI/CD, and strong developer productivity practices.
Experiment with emerging AI technologies and evaluate their fit for ourproducts, balancing speed-to-market with reliability.
Mentor and support other engineers, setting coding standards andarchitectural practices that ensure long-term maintainability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design AI-enabled productexperiences that meet real client needs.
Qualifications
5+ years of experience building robust, scalable full-stack applications,databases, and developer tools.
Hands-on experience working with LLMs or AI services (e.g., OpenAI,Anthropic, Vertex AI, Llama) in a professional or personal capacity.
Significant experience designing, building, deploying, and maintainingproduction applications at scale.
Proficiency with Javascript/Typescript, React, NodeJS (NestJS), andPostgresQL.
Familiarity with modern web technologies ( WebSockets, gRPC,GraphQL).
Comfort architecting solutions to ambiguous problems with significantimpact.
Experience leaving the codebase better than you found it throughautomated testing, CI/CD, and observability.
Nice to Haves
Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-enabled features (e.g.,measuring quality, accuracy, and reliability of LLM outputs).
Familiarity with RAG, embedding algorithms, and intent classification.
Experience with observability and monitoring systems (Langfuse,Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Cloudwatch, etc.).
Experience with infrastructure-as-code in production.
Familiarity with internal UI and integration tools (ReTool, SalesforceCommunities, Contentful, NextJS, etc.).
Experience with containers and orchestrators like Docker or Kubernetes.
Background in healthcare, regulated industries, or EHR/EMR integration.
Experience debugging distributed systems.
You do not need to have prior experience with every technology in our stack. We believe great candidates are capable of learning new tools quickly, and weprovide mentorship and guidance as needed.
We offer:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health/Sport Budget.
Fully remote.

My client is a $100m private investment fund that specialises in the medical aesthetics industry and has a network of warehouses globally that serve as local procurement centres which source and ship products to global customers

My client is looking for a consultant, or someone that they will work with on a contractual basis (you won't be an employee) who already has an existent business set up, in selling medical aesthetics (specifically dermal fillers and Botox injectables) into Health Care Practises / Beauty Salons / Clinics in Brazil.
They will be able to supply you with all the 3rd party sourced products (Botox and dermal fillers) and you will leverage your local network to help with the assortment, and you will use your own ground sales network to open up the Brazilian market for my client.
Brazil is a good market for this business, as is the wider LATAM region.
Maybe you own a beauty clinic, or chain of beauty clinics already in Brazil.
Maybe you used to work in Sales for the big global manufactures within medical aesthetics in Brazil and now you are on your own, working as a sales rep, and looking for new products to sell.
Maybe your run your own distribution business in Brazil and you have a huge network of beauty salons / clinics - that you already are selling too.
You must be fluent in English (written and verbal) to be relevant.
YOU MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE IN BRAZIL SELLING INTO BEAUTY CLINICS / AESTHETIC MEDICINE CLINICS for dermal fillers and injectables
only (not prescription medicine).
Responsibilities
Someone who will head up the on ground wholesale sales into Brazil in partnership with the the fund - To be relevant for this, you will already either be doing this currently, or have done this very recently in your background
You will be selling medical aesthetics like dermal fillers, Botox, injectables directly to any kind of healthcare clinic that uses them. Therefore you MUST have previous experience in selling to small - medium size health care practises who stock similar products.
Previous experience in selling to beauty salons, cosmetic GPs and Surgeons, Plastic Surgeons, Aesthetics GPs is essential for success within this capacity
This person, or partner, or business, will own the wholesale distribution for the Brazilian market
You will leverage your network in Brazil, and detailed product expertise within medical aesthetics, to help determine the price for resale as well as the wider assortment of products needed within the market. Where are the gaps? What are the gaps? You will bring detail expertise to the table here

title: Analista De Inteligência Antifraude Pl
description:
Você se identifica com a área de Antifraude Patrimonial?
Estamos em busca de um
Analista de Antifraude Patrimonial .
Se você quer desenvolver uma carreira desafiadora e fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica, nós queremos te conhecer!
Conheça nossa história:
A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.
Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas.
Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Realizar investigações da área Patrimonial;
Conduzir investigações, utilizando técnicas e ferramentas de investigações;
Analisar o comportamento irregular e fraudes da área Patrimonial;
Elaborar relatórios de Inteligência;
Entrevistas investigativas;
Acompanhamento de processos logísticos.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Experiência com análise de fraudes patrimoniais;
Pacote office nível intermediário.
Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
Trabalho em equipe;
Autogerenciamento e autoconhecimento;
Proatividade
INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS
Benefícios:
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Vale Transporte;
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Seguro de vida;
Gympass;
Auxílio educação;
Auxílio home-office;
Auxílio creche;
Plataforma de cursos online;
Day off (dia doaniversário);
Jornada flexível.
SOBRE NÓS
Você está pronto para fazer a diferença no combate às fraudes?
A GIF é a empresa certa para você!
Há quase 30 anos, a GIF iniciou sua jornada com uma missão muito clara: proteger os ativos dos nossos clientes. Desde então, temos nos dedicado a fortalecer negócios, tornando-os mais seguros e lucrativos. Atualmente, oferecemos mais de 10 soluções personalizadas, desenvolvidas para atender às necessidades específicas de cada cliente, independentemente do porte ou setor.
Nos últimos dois anos, fomos reconhecidos como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar (GPTW) e consolidamos nossa posição como um dos principais líderes no mercado de segurança e inteligência antifraude em toda a América Latina.
Todo esse progresso é resultado do comprometimento e dedicação da nossa equipe, composta por mais de 120 colaboradores, estrategicamente distribuídos principalmente entre São Paulo e Buenos Aires, operando em um modelo híbrido com escritórios nas duas cidades.
Junte-se a nós nessa jornada de confiança e na construção de um futuro mais seguro!

title: Analista De Cuentas
description:
Na Atmus, os funcionários são vistos primeiro como pessoas e depois como colegas. Damos-lhe a liberdade e a flexibilidade para dar o seu melhor e causar impacto. Trabalhe ao lado das pessoas mais inovadoras da atualidade e ajude a moldar o futuro com a Atmus.
Estamos à procura de um talentoso
Analista de contas a pagar e cobrar
para se juntar à nossa equipe. É necessário ter especialização em
Contabilidade, administração ou áreas relacionadas, sendo preferível ter experiência no mercado industrial ou automotivo.
Nesta função, você fará a diferença das seguintes maneiras:
Como Analista de Contas a Pagar e Cobrar será responsável por apoiar as funções através do processamento de contas a pagar, relatórios de despesas e contas a receber, além de outras tarefas necessárias. Esta posição está envolvida em vários processos financeiros, incluindo o manuseio correto de contas a pagar e a receber, o processamento preciso de relatórios de despesas e a gestão meticulosa de contas a receber.
Para ter sucesso nesta função, você realizará as seguintes atividades:
Responsabilidades de contas a receber e cobrar
-
Realizar o fechamento financeiro mensal das contas a receber, fornecendo relatórios, créditos de reembolso concedidos e saldo mensal à contabilidade.
-
Enviar faturas aos bancos, respeitando os requisitos contratuais, limites de cobertura da garantia, concentração de clientes e histórico da carteira.
-
Analisar diariamente as liquidações e monitorar a liquidez da carteira de cobranças nas instituições bancárias através do sistema francesinha, identificando recebimentos não cumpridos.
-
Avaliar pedidos de deduções em faturas, negociando com os clientes e verificando a legitimidade dos créditos solicitados.
-
Ler arquivos (extratos, remessas e faturas), corrigindo inconsistências ou erros.
-
Realizar reconciliações de contas no ERP, garantindo que todos os recebimentos sejam devidamente contabilizados.
-
Preparar relatórios analíticos de recebimentos mensais para apoiar as projeções de fluxo de caixa.
-
Apoiar análises de crédito, reunindo as informações e a documentação necessárias.
-
Relatar escrituras em casos de inadimplência.
-
Garantir a conformidade da documentação do cliente, monitorando certificados, licenças e autorizações de operação.
-
Entrar em contato com os clientes para atualizar licenças expiradas, mantendo os arquivos de controle atualizados.
-
Analisar as faturas disponíveis para adiantamentos de contas a receber, avaliando os impactos nos custos e na cobertura com os bancos, apoiando a tomada de decisões da administração.
Responsabilidades de contas a pagar
-
Registro de faturas e pagamentos nos sistemas de contas a pagar
-
Resolução de discrepâncias no sistema de registro de faturas
-
Revisão do cronograma de faturas para pagamento, preparação do lote de pagamentos no módulo AP
-
Processamento de cheques, transferências bancárias, no módulo de pagamentos AP, atividades relacionadas a boletos
-
Responder às consultas de fornecedores e usuários internos
-
Reconciliação de extratos de contas de fornecedores
-
Processamento de lançamentos contábeis
-
Atividades de fechamento do mês para contas a pagar
-
Reconciliação do razão geral com o módulo de contas a pagar
-
Preparação de análises e relatórios para a equipe de contas a pagar
-
Estabelecimento e manutenção de relacionamentos com outros departamentos financeiros e equipes de trabalho
Formação/Experiência
-
Setor: Conhecimento do mercado de manufatura, setores automotivo e industrial.
-
Mais de 2 anos de experiência em contabilidade ou finanças: Os candidatos devem possuir no mínimo dois anos de experiência prática em funções de contabilidade ou finanças.
-
Preferência por bacharelado em contabilidade ou finanças: embora não seja estritamente obrigatório, é altamente preferível um diploma de bacharel (B.A. ou B.S.) em Contabilidade, Finanças ou área de negócios relacionada.
-
Conhecimento das principais ferramentas (Excel, PowerPoint etc.): proficiência em softwares essenciais para negócios é fundamental. Isso inclui habilidades avançadas em Microsoft Excel para análise de dados e modelagem.
-
Familiaridade com sistemas ERP (Netsuite, QuickBooks etc.): Experiência de trabalho com sistemas de planejamento de recursos empresariais (ERP) é altamente desejável.
-
Idiomas: Inglês avançado essencial, espanhol preferencial.
Competências profissionais:
-
Competências avançadas de análise e comunicação/negociação.
-
Liderança e gestão de equipes e operações financeiras.
-
Gerencia processos de relatórios financeiros.
-
Gerencia o suporte financeiro para cumprir quaisquer requisitos governamentais, regulatórios ou locais, tais como requisitos fiscais e contábeis legais.
-
Flexibilidade e dinamismo.
-
Proatividade
Oferecemos

Beneficios de lei e superiores

title: Junior Data Analytics Consultant
description:
About Making Science
Making Science is an international digital acceleration company with over 1,200 experts across 15 markets, including Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Colombia, France, Italy, the UK, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Germany, Georgia, and the USA. As a proud consulting partner of Local Planet — the world’s premier network of independent media agencies — we deliver a suite of digital, technology, and performance marketing services to a global clientele. Our expertise spans digital marketing and MarTech, software and cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and SaaS, all underscored by a relentless pursuit of innovation.
Making Science was ranked 15th in the FT1000: Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies 2023. Committed to making a positive impact, Making Science actively engages in various ESG initiatives. We’ve joined forces with the Climate Pledge, the United Nations Global Compact, and Pledge1%, dedicating resources and efforts to support non-profit organizations. Through these endeavors, we are committed to driving meaningful change for a brighter, more sustainable future.
As part of its commitment to innovation, Making Science offers its clients end-to-end capabilities required for consulting, development, integration, and maintenance of advanced IT solutions. Our global network of delivery hubs not only fosters job growth but also serves as an incubator for cultivating top-tier tech talent, fueling projects that accelerate transformation and modernisation.
Our team is composed of digital native professionals, who have a wide knowledge in the different stages and disciplines of the digital transformation: Digital Strategy, Infrastructures, Software Development, Creativity and UX/UI Design, Digital Marketing, and Big Data.
Some details about your department
We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Analytics Consultant with a strong focus on Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to join our team in Brazil. In this role, you will be responsible for managing local data analytics projects, helping our clients to leverage their data to drive business decisions. You will be the go-to person for GA4 implementation, analysis, and reporting, working closely with our clients to understand their needs and deliver actionable insights.
What we’d like you to do
Implement, configure, and manage Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager (GTM) for our clients.
Develop and maintain dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide insights to stakeholders.
Analyze website and marketing campaign data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Manage local data analytics projects from inception to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time and within scope.
Collaborate with internal teams and clients to understand their business objectives and provide data-driven recommendations.
Provide training and support to clients on how to use and interpret GA4 data.
Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in digital analytics and GA4.
What we’d like you to bring
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Proven experience working with Google Analytics (GA4 is a must).
Experience with Google Tag Manager.
Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI, or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills.
Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
Perks of joining us
We give you complete stability with an indefinite job contract.
We offer a fixed salary according to your worth and experience, plus a performance based bonus.
Do you know someone that fits in Making Science? Refer him or her, and you can get a bonus if they’re hired!
Feedback is part of our day to day lives. We recognize a job well done through a continuous feedback model.
The opportunity to meet our international team with our Ambassadors Program.
We care about a healthy work-life balance. You can count on having flexible working hours and one day a week where you can work from home.
You will never stop learning with us: subsidized training, free language classes, learning capsules, an e-learning platform, and many more.
Work comfortably and follow your own style, because we don’t have a dress code.
We know how to have a good time!
Never go hungry with our free daily fruit and our vending machine card!
Take a break on our terrace, play foosball, darts, or PlayStation
Be a part of a young, adventurous, and professional team, with people you’ll grow fond of!

title: Global It Service Desk Analyst
description:
Kynetec is the global leader in agricultural and animal health market insights. We have a long history of market research expertise, specialising in animal health and nutrition, crop protection, farm machinery and equipment, seed/biotech and fertilisers.
Backed by a team of more than 850 market researchers, interviewers, data analysts, marketing scientists, research operation and data visualization specialists, our number one priority is to ensure that we deliver the highest-quality insight and foresight at the right time to enable our clients to confidently make the best decisions for their business.
Across the globe, our employees are located across 28 major agriculture and animal health countries. Our coverage extends to major and niche sectors of our industry, where we regularly undertake research projects in more than 80 countries.
We are actively seeking a 1st Line Support Engineer to join our in-house service desk team in Valinhos, São Paulo.
The successful candidate will be required to be in the office 3 days per week - 2 days in Valinhos and 1 day Piracicaba. It is essential you live within a commutable distance to the offices.
The Role:

Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área correlata.

Experiência comprovada com frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch e Scikit-learn).
Conhecimento aprofundado em fundamentos de IA generativa e uso de APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Cohere, Hugging Face).
Experiência sólida com bibliotecas de manipulação de dados (Pandas, NumPy) e para scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright).
Amplo conhecimento e experiência em frameworks de orquestração de agentes (CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph).
Expertise em Git, versionamento de código, integração de APIs REST/GraphQL e conceitos avançados de CI/CD e MLOps.
Sólida experiência com fluxos multi-agente e comunicação avançada entre agentes por meio de LLMs.
Experiência com deploy de agentes ou modelos em cloud e uso de Docker/Kubernetes para monitoramento de desempenho.

O candidato ideal deve ser proativo, curioso e focado em aprendizado contínuo. É essencial ter excelente comunicação interpessoal e a capacidade de colaborar com equipes diversas. Gostar muito de aprender;
Fomentar a troca de conhecimentos;
Facilidade para se comunicar - nível técnico e usuário;
Sem medo de perguntar. Sem medo de ensinar. Sem medo de apresentar suas ideias;

title: Senior Business Continuity Analyst
description:
Purpose of the Position
An Asian financial institution, recognized as one of the largest and among the leading banks worldwide, with a strong presence across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. In Brazil, the institution focuses on corporate and investment banking, providing clients with tailored financial solutions.
With a global reputation for stability and long-term relationships, the institution continues to invest in innovation, cybersecurity, and sustainability, reinforcing its commitment to responsible growth and the protection of client interests in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.
The main idea of this role is to protect the institution’s ability to deliver critical banking services during disruption by owning and advancing the BCM – Business Continuity Management program processes. This is a hands-on, orchestration-heavy position that translates global continuity standards into effective local execution and audit-ready evidence.
Concretely, the role:
Leads the BCM lifecycle end-to-end: conducts BIAs (criticality, dependencies, RTO/RPO), maintains BCPs, and plans/coordinates tests (e.G., DR/switch-over validations, contingency site, VDI/endpoint readiness, evacuation drills, call tree), including out-of-hours windows.
Turns results into decisions: surfaces risks, residual exposures, and disclaimers to risk committees;
drives lessons learned and closes open issues with robust documentation and owners/dates/evidence.
Connects BCM to the broader non-financial risk picture: interfaces with Operational Incidents, Vendor Risk, Products & Services, and RCSA so that continuity risks and control gaps are consistently identified, tracked, and remediated.
Bridges global and local: adapts global policy/standards to Brazil’s context, ensuring regulatory fit (BACEN) without diluting control integrity.
Influences without formal authority: engages senior stakeholders (e.G., Treasury and Operations leaders) to prioritize continuity activities, align on test windows, and validate outcomes;
partners with IT/IS to validate DR without performing technical changes.
Main Challenges and Assignments
Operate the existing Business Continuity framework while continuously improving its maturity, expanding coverage, and strengthening evidence quality.
Organize and document activities using spreadsheets and manual controls, ensuring that all records are audit-ready and compliant with internal and external requirements.
Plan, coordinate, and lead continuity tests, including out-of-hours exercises, anticipating risks, resolving issues on the spot, and making sound, well-reasoned decisions.
Adapt global policies and methodologies to the Brazilian regulatory context, maintaining alignment with global standards and full compliance with BACEN requirements.
Engage and influence critical business areas, such as Treasury and Operations, to secure collaboration and prioritization of BCM activities without direct authority.
Map critical processes, conduct Business Impact Analyses (BIA), and maintain updated Business Continuity Plans (BCP).
Develop, update, and review continuity policies, standards, and procedures, while supporting the management of open issues, regulatory requirements, and action plans.
Deliver training to teams and managers on continuity and disaster recovery procedures, proactively monitor external events and news for potential risks
This role will also involve executing other operational risk programs such as Operational Incident Management, Vendor/Product & Service Risk Management, etc.
Experience and Professional Qualifications
Bring solid experience gained over several years in financial institutions, with a proven track record in Business Continuity Management, including BIA, BCP, and continuity testing.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of operational resilience practices, with exposure to RCSA, operational incident management, and vendor/third-party risk.
Be comfortable coordinating with IT and Information Security (IS) teams during disaster recovery validations, leading and validating outcomes without performing the technical execution.
Possess proficiency in Excel for data analysis and tracking, and PowerPoint for building clear, executive-level presentations and reports.
Communicate effectively in English at a level to interact with global stakeholders and follow corporate standards.
Hold a degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems/Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field.
Knowledge of Bank Policies and Regulations, familiarity with cyber risk policies, procedures, and regulations, and the ability to review and ensure compliance with these requirements (Differential). Bring additional exposure to ISO 22301 standards, experience with tools such as Visio or Power BI/Power Query, and professional certifications in business continuity or disaster recovery (e.G., CBCP, DRII, BRCCI). (Differential)
Behavioral Skills
Executive communication & influence – Engages effectively with senior stakeholders, articulates complex topics in a clear, concise manner, and secures alignment in risk committees.
Proactivity & ownership – Demonstrates a self-starter mindset, acting hands-on and taking full responsibility for driving initiatives to completion.
Organization, discipline & critical thinking – Maintains audit-ready documentation with rigor and structure, while applying analytical thinking and sound judgment to make timely, well-reasoned decisions.
Collaboration & resilience – Partners seamlessly with Non-Tech areas and IT/IS, showing adaptability and composure under pressure, and adjusting course when unexpected challenges arise.

O Grupo Cobra como líder mundial no desenvolvimento de infraestruturas industriais e na prestação de serviços, possui como requisitos obrigatórios o Respeito à Diversidade, a Equidade e a Inclusão. Tendo em vista o compromisso com à contratação de pessoas com deficiência e com o desenvolvimento de suas carreiras profissionais, encorajamos pessoas com deficiência a participar deste processo seletivo. Assim como profissionais pertencentes à todas as identidades e expressões de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência visível e/ou invisível e origens étnico-raciais. Nossa equipe de R&S está pessoalmente à disposição para avaliar candidaturas das pessoas com deficiência para quaisquer outras vagas no Grupo Cobra Brasil.

Mapear e buscar ativamente PCDs nos projetos e canteiros de obras da empresa.
Realizar entrevistas, escutas ativas e visitas técnicas para identificar trabalhadores com deficiência, mesmo que ainda não formalmente declarados.
Atuar em conjunto com as equipes de obra, RH e medicina do trabalho para propor adaptações de postos de trabalho.
Desenvolver e aplicar estratégias de sensibilização e inclusão nos canteiros (palestras, DDS, cartilhas, campanhas).

title: Executivo de Vendas Presenciais de Soluções de Pagamentos - Mercado Pago - São Paulo Capital
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!
Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.
Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico.
Para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.
Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques.
Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.
Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:
Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.
Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores,
e sendo responsável por:
Representar o Mercado Pago em uma Região: percorrer áreas comerciais (loja a loja), identificar oportunidades, entender as necessidades dos lojistas e oferecer soluções personalizadas com os produtos e serviços do Mercado Pago (foco em maquininha de cartão).
Prospectar de forma estratégica: realizar abordagens porta a porta, 100% presenciais, com planejamento, disciplina e eficiência, superando metas e maximizando a satisfação das empresas credenciadas.
Garantir um excelente pós-venda: acompanhar o onboarding das empresas credenciadas, garantindo a ativação imediata, engajamento e principalidade de relacionamento com o Mercado Pago.
Competir em Equipe para Ganhar: participar ativamente das reuniões e demais atividades em equipe, compartilhando boas práticas, ideias inovadoras, contribuindo para a maximização dos resultados individuais e coletivos.
Requisitos:
Possuir formação superior completa ou estar cursando.
Possuir CNH "B” e Automóvel próprio (4 rodas) para uso diário.
Ter experiência consistente em vendas porta a porta (vendas externas).
Possuir disponibilidade para trabalhar nas regiões de atuação.
Nós lhe propomos:
Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)
O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

superior completo. Desejável especialização ou pós-graduação.

Domínio das regras de negócio de acordo com a área de atuação;

inglês e/ou espanhol intermediários - Diferencial

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
OPTIVIQ Inc. with roots in the Pulp & Paper Industry for nearly 40 years, holding the exclusive global license for the distribution and support of OptiVisionTM, a leading software solution for managing complex manufacturing processes. Owned by Constellation Software Inc., a global leader in vertical market software, we offer a unique environment that combines the flexibility of a medium-sized company with the opportunities and resources of a 50,000+ employee organization.
Division Link: Job Description
The OptiVisionTM Account Manager plays a critical role in managing and nurturing relationships with key customers. This role is responsible for being the primary point of contact for customer communication of technical topics, working with multiple accounts, and ensuring that customer needs are met by overseeing ticket management, release testing, and handling the estimation of enhancements process. The Account Manager will collaborate closely with the Customer Experience Manager, other Account Managers and internal teams to resolve customer issues in a timely manner and drive customer satisfaction.
Essential Duties And Responsibilities
Primary Customer Communication:
Serve as the key point of contact for assigned customers, maintaining regular communication and building strong relationships.
Product Knowledge:
Continue to develop and maintain a deep understanding of OPTIVIQ’s software solutions, including OptiVisionTM. Stay current with new product releases, features, and updates to provide accurate information and guidance to customers.
Customer Business Process Knowledge:
Continuously gain knowledge of the customer’s business processes and how they intersect with OptiVisionTM and other OPTIVIQ software solutions. Understand customer-specific workflows and requirements.
Ticket Management:
Oversee and manage customer tickets, ensuring timely responses and resolutions. Collaborate with support teams to escalate issues when necessary and track progress.
Release Testing (for Customers):
Coordinate and manage the testing of new releases for customers, ensuring that updates or new features function correctly in customer environments.
Enhancement Estimate Process:
Upon request from customers, create Enhancement Tickets, Statements of Work, Estimation of Efforts and Documents of Understanding, working closely with the Customer Experience Manager for the generation of quotes and proposals. Liaise with internal departments to track and fulfill customer requests.
Customer/Product Issue Resolution:
Identify and resolve customer and product-related issues. Serve as a problem-solving resource for customers and coordinate solutions with other departments.
Collaboration with Account Managers:
Work closely with other Account Managers to share knowledge, insights, and best practices. Collaborate on cross-functional customer projects and initiatives.
Timecard Maintenance:
Ensure proper timecard management for customer-related activities, ensuring accurate time tracking for billing and project purposes.
Knowledge of Tools and Reporting:
Develop expertise in the tools and reporting systems used by OPTIVIQ to manage customer accounts, monitor service delivery, and report on customer metrics.
Regular Customer Meetings:
Organize and participate in regular customer meetings to discuss ongoing projects, updates, and any outstanding issues. Maintain a proactive approach to customer engagement.
Manages Multiple Customers:
Successfully manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously, ensuring that each customer receives a high level of service and attention.
Required Skills & Experience
Product Knowledge:
Experience in using, configuring, supporting and maintaining OptiVisionTM
Experience in the Pulp and Paper industry
Customer Relationship Management:
Proven experience managing key accounts in a B2B environment, preferably within a software or technology company.
Business Process Understanding:
Ability to understand complex customer business processes and how they relate to the implementation and use of OptiVisionTM.
Issue Resolution
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying root causes and delivering effective solutions.
Communication Skills:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts in a clear and concise manner.
Portuguese and English – Advanced Level
Ability to Travel Internationally
Organizational Skills:
Ability to manage multiple customer accounts, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines.
Technical Aptitude:
Experience with CRM systems, service ticketing tools, and reporting systems.
Team Collaboration:
Ability to work well in cross-functional teams and share knowledge with peers.
Desired Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
A minimum of 5 years in a customer-facing role with account management experience.
Familiarity with SQL or other database querying skills is a plus.
Essential Functions
For up to 8 hours per day you must be able to fully utilize standard computer equipment, required programs, phone, and office equipment. You must be able to lift and carry a laptop computer.

Tech Lead
em
Framework
na área de Foundation da Sankhya, você terá um papel estratégico na arquitetura e evolução da nossa infraestrutura tecnológica.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
Liderar decisões técnicas relacionadas aos frameworks de back-end da aplicação.
Garantir qualidade, padronização e boas práticas no desenvolvimento de software.
Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos para manter a coerência e a evolução do codebase.
Antecipar problemas técnicos e propor soluções robustas e escaláveis.
Manter a documentação técnica e o material de onboarding sempre atualizados.
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
Pós-graduação em Arquitetura de Software ou de Soluções
Pós-graduação em Gestão de Pessoas é desejável
Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend, arquitetura de software e liderança técnica.
Histórico de participação em projetos escaláveis e performáticos.
Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
Portfólio técnico relevante (GitHub, projetos ou contribuições open source).
Competências Técnicas
Domínio Profundo do Ecossistema Java:
Java moderno: Spring Boot e ecossistema (security, data, etc.), Quarkus (desempenho), etc. para injeção de dependências, programação reativa, microsserviços, etc.
Java legado: Java EE (JSP, Servlets, EJB), Struts, JSF, etc. para manutenção, convivência, modernização, ,migração e/ou refatoração.
JVM e performance: domínio da JVM (garbage collection e tuning).
Arquitetura de Software e Design Patterns:
Desenho de soluções desacopladas, coesas e de fácil manutenção.
Capacidade de tomar decisões arquiteturais importantes e justificar suas decisões com base em requisitos técnicos e/ou de negócio.
Especialista em padrões de projetos clássicos (GoF: Gang of Four) e para microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos.
Expertise em Back-end e Visão Abrangente de Front-end:
Back-end: Java, DB (SQL: Oracle/SQL Sever, e NoSQL), mensageria (Kafka ou RabbitMQ), construção de APIs RESTful robustas e bem documentadas.
Front-end: é necessário conhecimento sólido dos fundamentos de front-end: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React e Angular.
Cultura de DevOps e Automação:
Experiência em CI/CD com GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.
Conhecimento de conteinerização com: Kubernetes, Docker, Nexus, etc.
Experiência e espírito de testes automatizados: unitários, integração e performance.
Qualidade, Segurança e Manutenção:
Code review, análise estática e dinâmica de código (SONAR), avaliação de métricas de qualidade do codebase.
Mentalidade de “segurança desde a concepção” e no caso de manutenção “a intervenção mínima e segura que resolve o problema”, sem sub ou over engineering.
Se você busca um desafio para liderar a evolução tecnológica de um dos maiores ERPs do país, com impacto direto na experiência de milhares de usuários, queremos te conhecer!

title: Events Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN
SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented
Events Specialist
to spearhead our presence and engagement initiatives within the local market. This role is crucial in building and nurturing strong relationships with key organizations, particularly shopping malls and local businesses, to drive brand visibility, foster community ties, and support our strategic objectives, including the growth of the SHEIN Marketplace. The ideal candidate will be an exceptional communicator, a meticulous planner, and a proactive relationship builder with a proven track record in event management and stakeholder engagement.
Key Responsibilities:
Strategic Relationship Management:
Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key external organizations, including shopping malls, local businesses, industry associations, and community groups.
Identify and cultivate new partnership opportunities that align with SHEIN's regional goals and brand values.
Act as the primary point of contact and ambassador for SHEIN in regional interactions, ensuring consistent brand messaging and positive representation.
Event Planning & Execution:
Design, plan, and execute a diverse portfolio of regional events, activations, and promotional projects, often in collaboration with other partners.
Oversee all logistical aspects of events, including venue selection, vendor coordination, staffing, permits, and materials.
Ensure all events are meticulously organized, on-brand, and deliver an exceptional experience for attendees and partners.
Budget Management & Optimization:
Develop, manage, and meticulously track budgets for all events and partnership initiatives, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial guidelines.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and partners to secure favorable terms and maximize ROI.
Provide regular financial reporting and analysis on event expenditures.
Regional Representation & Communication:
Represent SHEIN at regional industry events, meetings, and community gatherings, networking effectively to enhance brand perception and uncover new opportunities.
Develop and deliver compelling presentations about SHEIN's initiatives (e.g., Marketplace, new campaigns) to various external stakeholders.
Collaborate with internal marketing and communications teams to ensure consistent messaging and promotion of regional activities.
Project Management:
Lead and manage complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, such as setting up stands, events, or joint marketing campaigns with shopping malls / industry associations.
Develop detailed project plans, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring projects are completed on time and within scope.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, and implement solutions to challenges that arise during planning or execution.
Reporting & Analysis:
Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for all events and partnerships, providing comprehensive post-event reports and insights.
Utilize data to evaluate the success of initiatives and inform future strategy development.
Local Travel:
Frequent local travel within the designated region will be required to attend meetings and oversee event execution.
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Event Management, Public Relations, or a related field.
5 years of proven experience in event management, community relations, and/or partnership development, preferably within retail, e-commerce, or a fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated experience in managing budgets, negotiating contracts, and optimizing resources for events.
Strong track record of building and nurturing successful relationships with diverse organizations and stakeholders.
Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently, from conception to completion.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with proven ability to deliver engaging presentations.
Proactive, results-oriented, and highly organized with meticulous attention to detail.
Ability to work independently, make sound decisions, and adapt to a dynamic work environment.
Fluency in Portuguese and Mandarim is mandatory.
Fluency in English is a plus.
Willingness and ability to travel locally as required.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in the e-commerce or fashion retail industry.
Familiarity with the regional market landscape, including key shopping centers and local organizations.
Experience presenting to large groups or external partners.
At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.
A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.
Sobre a Tereos
Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Senior Flutter Developer
Location:
Remote
Contract:
PJ (full-time)
Level:
Senior
We’re building a
virtual office platform
for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together
persistent rooms ,
real-time presence ,
audio/video (WebRTC) ,
chat ,
screen sharing ,
collaborative boards , and
immersive spaces
to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.
The Role
We’re looking for a
Senior Flutter Developer
focused on
macOS Desktop
to build and evolve our desktop client. You’ll ship a
high-performance, stable, and well-instrumented
app that integrates video/audio, real-time features, and collaborative tools—while keeping top-tier code quality, testing, and documentation.
Secondary scope:
help maintain
Android and iOS
builds (feature parity, fixes, and releases).
What You’ll Do
Design, build, and maintain the
Flutter macOS
app with clean architecture, modular layers, and reliable
state management .
Integrate
RESTful APIs
and
real-time services
(e.g.,
WebSockets/Streams ).
Implement
A/V
features (e.g., flutter_webrtc): device selection, camera/mic permissions, I/O routing, and stability under variable networks.
Ensure
observability
end to end: instrument product events/metrics; triage errors with
Sentry ; capture UX signals with
Microsoft Clarity
(session replay/heatmaps) where applicable (web/embedded views); analyze performance traces and dashboards.
Own
quality : unit, widget, and integration tests; CI checks; code reviews; technical docs.
Handle
macOS distribution : code signing &
notarization , entitlements,
Hardened Runtime ,
App Sandbox , Keychain; package
DMG/PKG ; manage
auto-update
(e.g., Sparkle).
Collaborate with Product/Design/QA to refine requirements, edge cases, and acceptance criteria; keep specs tidy in Confluence and PRs clear.
Team rituals & reporting:
Attend
daily standups in English
and other ceremonies (planning, grooming, demos, retros).
Keep
Jira
up to date (status, links, attachments) and
log time entries (work logs)
per task.
Submit an
end-of-day (EOD) daily report in English
including:
hours worked
(per task), what was completed, current task & ETA, blockers, and plan for tomorrow.
Secondary (Android & iOS):
maintain parity when applicable, fix platform-specific issues, help with
CI/CD
and
store releases , monitor crashes/perf via
Sentry
and review UX insights with
Clarity
when relevant.
CPU & GPU Optimizations (primary focus)
CPU
Minimize rebuilds: effective
state selection
(BLoC/Riverpod/Provider),
const
constructors, proper
Keys , split large widgets.
Cut redundant layout/work: avoid heavy logic in build, cache computed values, reduce intrinsic measurements, coalesce events,
debounce/throttle
streams.
Move heavy tasks off the UI thread:
isolates
(compute/custom), lazy JSON parsing, incremental work units.
Frame scheduling discipline: prevent setState loops; render only when state actually changes.
GPU
Reduce
overdraw/repaints : place
RepaintBoundary
wisely; optimize
CustomPainter
(shouldRepaint); avoid large
Opacity
on complex subtrees.
Avoid expensive effects: minimize
saveLayer , heavy
blurs/gradients
and big
shadows .
Use right-sized images &
filterQuality
(low/none when acceptable); limit transforms on large layers.
Shader jank
control: warm up shaders / capture
SkSL
where applicable; keep fragment shaders simple.
Pause/disable animations when off-screen; keep animation count/area minimal.
Measurement & Guardrails:
Profile with
Flutter DevTools
(CPU/GPU/frame timeline) and add
perf budgets
(avg CPU%/GPU frame time) to CI gates.
Track before/after metrics per feature; regressions must be fixed before release.
Must-Haves
Fluent English
(spoken and written): comfortable in
daily English standups
and writing EOD reports.
Strong experience with
Flutter
and
Dart
building
Desktop
apps (preferably
macOS ).
Proven work
reducing CPU/GPU usage
in Flutter apps (ideally desktop/macOS) with measurable before/after results.
Solid grasp of
architectural patterns
( MVC/MVVM/Clean ),
DI , and
state management
(BLoC/Riverpod/Provider).
Hands-on with
RESTful APIs ,
WebSockets/Streams ,
async/isolates , and robust error handling.
Firebase
(Auth, Firestore, Analytics)
or equivalent ,
Microsoft Clarity
(for UX/session insights in web-embedded contexts), and
Sentry
for error/performance monitoring.
Git proficiency, code reviews, CI (e.g.,
GitHub Actions/GitLab CI ), and
Jira work logs/time tracking .
Nice to Have
Deep
macOS
expertise: signing,
notarization ,
App Sandbox , entitlements, Keychain, packaging, and updater pipelines.
Practical
WebRTC
experience; spatial audio; jitter/latency tuning.
Android/iOS
publishing (fastlane or equivalent), push notifications, and in-app review flows.
Docker ,
CDN , and networking basics for real-time apps.
Accessibility (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and internationalization.
Benefits & Environment
Remote-first, flexible hours, and
competitive market range .
Fast feedback loops, ownership, and a product with real impact on how teams work every day.
Support for learning, events, and continuous improvement.

Atuar como ponto focal da performance operacional, cobrando entregas e facilitando a resolução de problemas.

Identificar desvios e riscos operacionais antes que impactem os resultados;
Estruturar e acompanhar planos de correção com os responsáveis de cada área.

Desenvolver análises preditivas e uso de inteligência artificial para melhorar visibilidade, previsibilidade e eficiência operacional.
Qualidade Operacional

Apoiar auditorias internas, revisões executivas e iniciativas de padronização de processos.

Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
pós-graduação/MBA será considerado diferencial.

Experiência em condução de rituais de governança, acompanhamento de KPIs e gestão de planos de ação.
Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interdepartamental, com perfil de cobrança estruturada e colaborativa.

title: Managing Director
description:

XCELiS is made up of a team of Supply Chain specialists with over 15 years of experience optimizing and transforming business results in Brazil and abroad.
We operate end-to-end across the supply chain, from design to implementation, delivering performance optimization and results-driven projects in areas such as Logistics Network, Transportation, Warehousing, Planning, E-Commerce/Omnichannel, Procurement, Technology, and Control Tower.
We are certified in Organizational Climate by FEEx 2023 and 2024, recognized as leaders in
Supply Chain Advisory and Consulting Services
and as Contender in the
Supply Chain IT Operation Services
quadrant of the ISG Provider LensTM Supply Chain Services Brazil 2023 study. In addition, we were awarded 1st place by INBRASC in 2023 in the categories
Logistics Consulting
and
TMS Provider .
Job descripiton:
The Managing Director in Supply Chain Transformation at XCELiS is a senior, entrepreneurial, and visionary leader responsible for expanding new business and leading end-to-end supply chain transformation projects. This professional will combine deep expertise in logistics, planning (S&OP), procurement, and digital technologies. The goal is to position XCELiS as the leading consulting firm in supply chain solutions, delivering measurable value, pragmatism, resilience, competitive advantage, and results for our clients.
Key Responsibilities
Business Development and Market Strategy
Manage the financial performance (P&L) of projects in partnership with the finance team.
Lead the prospecting of complex Supply Chain projects, from diagnosis to the implementation of S&OP, logistics, and digitalization solutions.
Act as the primary advisor to C-level clients (CSCO, COO, CEO), translating their business challenges into robust supply chain strategies.
Develop and price value propositions that clearly demonstrate ROI, focusing on cost optimization, service improvement, and risk mitigation.
Represent XCELiS in the Supply Chain ecosystem by speaking at events, publishing articles, and building a strong professional network.
Leadership and Delivery of Supply Chain Projects
Oversee the delivery of a portfolio of projects, ensuring the application of best practices in demand planning, inventory management, logistics network optimization, and automation.
Provide final review and strategic guidance to project teams, ensuring solutions are not only theoretical but also practical and high-impact.
Manage the inherent challenges of transformation projects, such as change management, system integration (ERP, WMS, TMS), and stakeholder alignment.
Lead and mentor a team of specialized Supply Chain consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.
Identify emerging trends (AI in logistics, blockchain, sustainability in supply chains) and develop new service offerings for XCELiS.
Qualifications and Competencies
Academic Background
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Industrial, Mechanical, etc.), Business Administration, or Economics.
Postgraduate degree, MBA, Master’s, or PhD with a focus on Supply Chain or Logistics is highly desirable.
Technical Skills (Supply Chain)
End-to-end supply chain expertise: Planning (S&OP/IBP), Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics (Transportation and Warehousing), and Customer Service.
Proven experience leading logistics network optimization projects, distribution center design, TMS/WMS implementation, and inventory management strategies.

title: Analista administrativo
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?
Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.
Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.
No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m2.
Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.
Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.
No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.
A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.
Como nosso Analista Administrativo, você irá:
Preparar e revisar apresentações, relatórios e materiais de reunião (PowerPoint, Excel, Word);
Apoiar a equipe em tarefas administrativas e de coordenação, garantindo o bom funcionamento das operações diárias;
Auxiliar no agendamento, preparação de reuniões e organização de documentos;
Dar suporte em tarefas básicas de contabilidade, controle de despesas e emissão de faturas;
Colaborar de perto com a alta gestão para assegurar a entrega pontual das demandas.
Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:
Superior Completo em Administração, Contabilidade e/ou áreas correlatas;
Domínio do pacote Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word);
Conhecimentos básicos em processos de contabilidade e faturamento;
Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e de comunicação.
Perfil proativo, detalhista e confortável em atuar em um ambiente internacional dinâmico;
Inglês avançado.

title: Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
description:
Infrastructure Project Manager (Data Center Migration & Network Support)
Brazil
Duration: 1 Year + Possibility of extension
Full time - Onsite
Job Description
We're seeking an organized, proactive coordinator to support a co-managed data center migration from on-premises to the comanaged location. This role will partner with global teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to plan, track, and execute migration activities, while also supporting ongoing infrastructure and network operations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, an excellent communicator, and experienced in coordinating complex infrastructure projects across time zones.
Key Responsibilities Project coordination for data center migration:
Assist in developing and maintaining the migration project plan, timelines, milestones, and dependencies.
Coordinate discovery and inventory of applications, servers, storage, network devices, and interdependencies.
Support readiness assessments, migration runbooks, fallback plans, and post-migration validation.
Track risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies (RAID), and drive mitigation or escalation.
Schedule and facilitate migration waves, change windows, and cutover activities with cross-functional teams.
Maintain clear documentation, status reports, and decision logs.
Global stakeholder engagement:
Serve as a central point of contact across global infrastructure, network, security, application, and operations teams.
Coordinate with the co-managed data center provider at the comanaged location and relevant third-party vendors.
Organize and lead recurring standups, working sessions, and steering updates;
capture and distribute minutes and action items.
Escalate blockers to the appropriate leadership and functional teams with context and recommended next steps.
Infrastructure and network support:
Support day-to-day infrastructure and network-related activities tied to the migration (e.G., change coordination, maintenance scheduling, access requests).
Coordinate network changes, including VLANs, routing updates, firewall rule requests, WAN/Internet transitions, and load balancer configurations as directed by SMEs.
Help track capacity planning inputs (compute, storage, network bandwidth) and ensure alignment with target-state designs.
Assist in validating connectivity, performance baselines, and post-migration health checks with monitoring teams.
Governance, compliance, and change management:
Ensure changes follow change control processes, maintenance windows, and communication protocols.
Coordinate audit-ready documentation for migrations, including approvals, test results, and backout plans.
Partner with security and compliance teams on control requirements, access provisioning, and data handling policies.
Cutover and hypercare support:
Coordinate pre-cutover checkpoints, go/no-go decisions, and stakeholder communications.
Track hypercare issues, triage to the right teams, and ensure timely resolution and handoff to steady-state operations.
Capture lessons learned and contribute to playbooks for subsequent migration waves.
Communication and reporting:
Maintain dashboards, trackers, and concise status updates for technical teams and leadership.
Provide clear escalation paths, SLAs/ETAs, and communication cadences across time zones.
Keep project artifacts current in the designated PM and documentation tools.
Vendor and contract coordination:
Liaise with co-location and managed service providers for circuit turn-ups, cross-connects, racking/stacking schedules, remote hands, and logistics.
Track vendor deliverables and dependencies;
escalate variances proactively.
Logistics and asset coordination:
Support shipment, receiving, and chain-of-custody processes for hardware moves.
Coordinate decommissioning, data sanitization workflows, and disposal certificates for retired assets.
Quality and risk management:
Assist with test plans for application and infrastructure validation (connectivity, performance, failover).
Monitor risk indicators (timeline slippage, capacity shortfalls, change collisions) and raise timely alerts.
Preferred Qualifications Experience coordinating data center or large-scale infrastructure migrations in a co-managed or hybrid environment.
Familiarity with core infrastructure concepts: servers/virtualization, storage, networking (routing, switching, firewalls, load balancers), DNS, and monitoring.
Hands-on experience with project coordination tools (e.G., Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, or similar).
Strong meeting facilitation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to work across global time zones and manage competing priorities.
Nice to Have:
Exposure to disaster recovery planning, backup/restore coordination, and business continuity exercises.
Understanding of change management frameworks and ITIL concepts.
Experience with inventory discovery tools and CMDB hygiene efforts.
Success Indicators:
On-time delivery of migration milestones with minimal incidents.
Clear, consistent communication and timely escalation of risks/issues.
Accurate, audit-ready documentation and repeatable runbooks for each migration wave.
Smooth handoffs from project to operations and measurable reduction in post-migration issues.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Singular
Singular is a leader in mobile marketing analytics, helping top brands unify marketing data, measure performance, and optimize growth.
We’re looking for a
Revenue Operations Manager
to take ownership of our GTM tech stack, streamline systems and processes, and ensure our tools and data work in perfect sync to drive smarter, faster decision-making across sales and marketing.
About the Role
As the Revenue Operations Manager, you will own and optimize our entire go-to-market (GTM) tech stack. You’ll be the architect and the mechanic, making sure our systems (like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, Clay, Chili Piper, Gong, etc.) work in harmony, support efficient workflows, and surface the right insights to drive growth.
If you’re passionate about eliminating bloat, streamlining tools, and enabling teams to move fast, we want to hear from you.
What You’ll Do
Own and optimize our GTM tech stack—evaluating tool usage, reducing redundancy, and integrating platforms for seamless data flow
Serve as SFDC administrator and power user: manage workflows, fields, objects, and automation to ensure our CRM supports sales, marketing, and customer success
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and CS teams to design efficient processes across lead routing, scoring, attribution, pipeline hygiene, and reporting
Build and maintain reports/dashboards that help us track key metrics (e.G., pipeline velocity, conversion rates, campaign ROI)
Lead tool onboarding and offboarding, including vendor management and training
Be the go-to connector between systems, solving data gaps, syncing issues, and ensuring reliable reporting
Stay ahead of new features and capabilities across our GTM tools, constantly improving how we work
Continuously analyze GTM data across the funnel to identify trends, test hypotheses, and propose actionable improvements across sales, marketing, and customer touchpoints
Support forecasting, capacity planning, and performance analysis to help leadership make informed, data-driven decisions
What You Bring to the Role
Proven experience managing GTM tools, especially Salesforce, HubSpot, and at least 2–3 of the following: Apollo, Clay, Chili Piper, Gong
Strong experience in B2B SaaS GTM models, ideally supporting both SLG and PLG motions
Hands-on SFDC admin experience with the ability to build and troubleshoot workflows, custom fields, automation, and integrations
Strong understanding of B2B revenue operations and the connection between sales, marketing, and customer success
Ability to simplify complex tech ecosystems and eliminate unnecessary tools or processes
Analytical mindset: you know your way around dashboards, attribution, and pipeline metrics
Comfortable rolling up your sleeves but also thinking strategically about how tech can unlock growth
Curious, fast learner, and a proactive problem-solver
Bonus Points
One or more of the following Salesforce certifications:
Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator
Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder
Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant
Experience with data tools (e.G., Looker, Tableau, or similar)
Experience supporting ABM or multi-touch attribution models
Equal Opportunity
As a proud equal opportunity employer, we're committed to hiring top talent regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.
We don't just accept differences — we celebrate you being who you are for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.

title: Agriculture Specialist
description:
Job Title:
Rater – Crop Classification in Satellite and Street View Images
Project Goal
The objective of this project is to classify crop types from satellite imagery by leveraging high-quality crop labels derived from street-view images of fields, providing a scalable ground-truth dataset for agricultural research and AI training.
Responsibilities
Review satellite and street-view images to determine crop type or classify areas as uncultivated based on visual cues.
Follow established workflows and annotation protocols to ensure consistent and accurate labeling.
Apply domain knowledge to identify crop types even under partial occlusion.
Maintain accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency across large volumes of images.
Workflow
Agricultural Area Presence
– Confirm if agricultural fields occupy more than a defined percentage (e.G., 40%) of the image view.
Field Visibility Assessment
– Evaluate visibility of the field:
Partially Occluded but Identifiable
– Annotate the crop type or mark as uncultivated.
Clearly Visible and Identifiable
– Proceed to assign the correct crop label.
Qualifications
Academic Background : Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Agriculture, Agronomy, Crop Science, Agricultural Engineering, Horticulture, or a related field.
Hands-on Experience : Knowledge in Geography, Remote Sensing, Environmental Science, or GIS with exposure to crop identification.
Agriculture Experience : Previous involvement in crop identification, agricultural surveys, or image annotation.
Visual Identification Skills : Ability to distinguish crop types from both partial and full views.
Preferred Skills
Strong attention to detail and familiarity with diverse crop types.
Prior experience using image annotation tools and platforms is an advantage.
Ability to work independently and deliver results under defined timelines.

Os resultados esperados incluem aceleração na aquisição de novos clientes, maior conversão nas etapas do funil, aumento no volume de compras e vendas, melhor desempenho de produtos e expansão da cobertura de mercado nos territórios atribuídos.

Brasília/ Goiâna (modelo 100% campo)

Apresentar e executar oportunidades (canal, geografia, produto, desempenho, atendimento ao cliente, iniciativas-chave, preço, etc.) utilizando todos os dados disponíveis. Construir e compartilhar o plano completo para recrutamento e aquisição de novos clientes.
Construir e manter relações sólidas por meio de liderança com nossos Distribuidores Chave (Elite, Premier, Royal, Blue, etc.) e stakeholders internos para executar iniciativas estratégicas. Realizar reuniões periódicas para revisão de negócios dos territórios. Fornecer orientação aos escritórios regionais implementando planos de ação personalizados para cada rede.
Ser um membro ativo em campo, ouvindo oportunidades de melhoria.
Participar ativamente de atividades de prospecção, como feiras, estandes promocionais e eventos de recrutamento para apoiar a expansão da rede.
Coordenar treinamentos essenciais para o distribuidor: vendas (geração de leads, processo de vendas, recrutamento, etc.), finanças, produto, serviço, compliance, jurídico, digital. Ser o elo de ligação entre o Distribuidor e a Hy Cite.
Garantir que estratégias de incentivos, eventos, promoções de vendas e lançamentos de novos produtos sejam implementados e executados conforme orientação da Hy Cite.
Compreender e aderir aos padrões legais/de conformidade incluídos nas políticas corporativas e assumir responsabilidade pelas tarefas que atendem aos requisitos legais/de conformidade. Reportar violações de conformidade quando identificadas.
REQUISITOS
FORMAÇÃO:
Graduação completa em instituição reconhecida.
HABILIDADES E CONHECIMENTOS:
Experiência comprovada em vendas e gestão de equipes, com forte atuação em vendas diretas. Experiência prévia em marketing multinível é altamente desejável.
Capacidade demonstrada de trabalhar colaborativamente em equipes, com forte orientação de serviço tanto para stakeholders internos quanto para parceiros externos como Distribuidores.
Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade para engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos. Capacidade de desenvolver planos estratégicos e apresentações de forma independente.
Forte habilidade de autogestão e priorização, com capacidade de lidar com tarefas, iniciativas e projetos com supervisão mínima, inclusive em ambientes de trabalho remoto.
Perfil analítico e proficiência na gestão de dados de vendas, com experiência prática (preferencial) em Excel e ferramentas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Tableau, entre outras.
Orientação para resultados e execução, com atitude proativa, compromisso com a excelência e abertura para aprender sobre o negócio.
Fortes habilidades de negociação e construção de relacionamentos, com capacidade de influenciar stakeholders internos e parceiros externos (Distribuidores).
Espanhol é desejável.
O cargo é remoto. Requer 50% ou mais de viagens para atividades em campo e visitas a escritórios de Distribuidores.

title: Gerente de Fast-Food
description:

title: Analista De Recebíveis
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems.
